name: GPT-5.4 Pro
short: OpenAI's higher-compute tier (1.05M/128K, $30/$180, Responses-only) for hard research; GPQA 94.4%, ARC-AGI-2 83.3%, HLE 58.7% with tools.
standout: OpenAI’s earlier extra-compute tier for the hardest research questions — abstract puzzles and expert-level software tasks under long deliberation.
tradeoff: Extreme pricing and a Responses-API-only surface; succeeded by cheaper Pro-tier reasoning elsewhere in the lineup.
